prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions remain unreliable: high positive forecasts frequently overpredicted impact, while zero or negative forecasts sometimes preceded strong wins.
Adding new screens at the finish stage (finish, new_screen) consistently hurt performance across both agreeing tests (-15.5% and -8.8%).
Adding new flows during adoption (adoption, new_flow) consistently hurt performance or showed no clear effect across all 3 tests (-13.2%, -0.9%, and -4.5%).
Finish copy updates (finish, copy) showed no clear effect across both agreeing tests (+0.9% and +1.9%).
Waiting screen info updates (home, wait_info) mostly showed no clear effect across 9 of 13 tests, despite 3 winning tests (+6.4%, +3.6%, and +2.7%).
Kinds of changes with only 1 test provide weak evidence and cannot be treated as established patterns until replicated.

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Story Screen Spotlight Layout Redesign: Redesigns the story screen using a spotlight layout to highlight the pet companion concept before path selection. (why: The choose_path stage has a high mean time (514s), suggesting users linger on early story content without clear visual focus.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Pick Friend Carousel View Redesign: Redesigns the pick_friend screen with a carousel layout showcasing starter pets one at a time. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 78.8% with an average time of 1017s; a carousel makes browsing options faster and cleaner.)
2: [sign_in, redesign] Sign In Stage Layout Redesign: Rebuilds the sign-in screen using a stage layout to highlight authentication methods sequentially. (why: Sign-in drops 11.9% of users and has an average completion time of 567s, indicating visual friction.)
3: [home, redesign] Waiting Screen Stage Layout Redesign: Redesigns the waiting screen layout to a stage layout showing generation visual feedback. (why: The waiting step has a long mean time (2336s); clear stage visuals keep users reassured during setup.)
4: [adoption, redesign] Adoption Certificate Carousel Layout Redesign: Presents the adoption certificate in a carousel layout emphasizing pet details and confirmation. (why: Adoption is the biggest funnel drop step (78.8% conversion); presenting certificate confirmation clearly improves completion confidence.)
5: [adoption, hint] Upload Photos Photo Quality Advice Hint: Adds a hint on the photo upload screen advising on clear photo upload requirements for custom pet creation. (why: Users reported issues where custom pet generation failed or looked wrong in support tickets (3 emails).)
6: [finish, hint] Home Intro Desktop Controls Guide Hint: Displays a hint on home_intro explaining how to access desktop pet controls and system tray menu. (why: Support mail shows confusion after onboarding about how to control, hide, or talk to the pet (3 emails).)
7: [choose_path, hint] Choose Path Companion Selection Hint: Adds a helpful hint on the path choice screen clarifying that custom and pre-made paths can both be customized later. (why: Mean time on choose_path is high (514s), showing decision paralysis when picking a path.)
8: [home, wait_info] Waiting Screen Docking Stage Visual Hint: Adds a clear hint on the waiting screen explaining that the pet docks into the desktop system tray when ready. (why: Users report pets missing from desktop or not opening (3 support emails); clarifying docking behavior reduces confusion.)
